in_sanskrit.name: पर्वेज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is near or close, or the one who is on the side.

in_hindi.name: परवेज
in_hindi.meaning: पर (par) - near, close, side + वेज (vej) - to go
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who goes near or is close, or the one who is on the side.

in_tamil.name: பரவேஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: பர (par) - near, close + வேஜ் (vej) - to go
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who goes near or is close.

in_telugu.name: పరవేజ్
in_telugu.meaning: పర (par) - near, close + వేజ్ (vej) - to go
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who goes near or is close.

in_marathi.name: Parbej
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Fields
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parbej हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Parabrajaka: One who has transcended all worldly desires and has attained the supreme knowledge of the universe. The term is derived from the words Paras (supreme) and Brahmajaka (one who has acquired supreme knowledge).

in_bengali.name: Parbej
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Fields
in_bengali.long_meaning: Parbej একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Parabrajaka: One who has transcended all worldly desires and has attained the supreme knowledge of the universe. The term is derived from the words Paras (supreme) and Brahmajaka (one who has acquired supreme knowledge).
